page.notes: Greek and Hebrew readings are uncertain in several places: the first word of the page ("Τπρεῖν"), "ἐωΰλον", "ἀσπαγάλυς", "ἐπιδὰν", "προίληται" and the Hebrew "ערוה" were read from a small, low-contrast scan and should be checked against the original. The commentary block is set in smaller type inside the column, so it is marked as a foot paragraph. The word "antiqua" is split at the line end as "an-" and "tiqua"; the second part is recorded as the catchword.
